title: Schema-First Operation Vocabularies Only
rationale: AI must never output arbitrary JSX or mutate arbitrary React state. All actions are compiled into typed AIOperation objects validated against COMPONENT_REGISTRY.

title: Direct History System Integration via pushHistory
rationale: Do NOT create a disconnected secondary AI history stack. Push snapshots to builder history so standard Undo/Redo actions effortlessly restore pre-AI state.
implications: Single source of truth for history

title: Strict Bounded Agent Execution with Ceiling Guardrails
rationale: Autonomous agents must never run in unbounded loops. DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 15 ceiling and 3-step duplicate action detector guarantee safe halts.

title: Durable Disk-Backed Checkpointing in .phase7
rationale: Implementations must survive IDE crashes, restarts, and interruptions without losing verified work or fabricating unverified progress.

title: Unified End-to-End Pipeline & Hard Safety Boundaries
rationale: All Phase 7 capabilities (Builder, Agent, Transactions, Recovery, Security) integrate into a unified pipeline where safety controls (NoEval, SecretFilter, Permission checks, Approval gates) can never be bypassed.
implications: Crash and interruption survival without state duplication
Strict preservation of the frozen 776/776 Phase 1-6 baseline
